Recognizable hardware components with visible depth, unlabelled, set against a generous empty margin, architectural precision.

Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a weathered brushed steel surface. An interlocking arrangement featuring a heavy finned graphics compute block, an unlatched inspection gate, and a thick braided power cable connector. Extreme asymmetry, hero off-centre right with heavy negative space left. Matte muted palette, hard clean edges, tactile industrial materials. One directional key light throwing a long cast shadow to the left.

prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph, 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane. A heavy-duty, braided electrical power cable firmly locked into the brushed aluminum heat-sink fins of a high-end workstation compute module. Shallow depth of field, visible surface texture, metallic dust, and heavy contact shadows. Soft directional daylight striking the metallic fins, creating stark highlights against deep shadows, with the background falling away into smooth, dark editorial negative space. The hero object is positioned asymmetrically on the right third of the frame.
